1. Pick the region and open the link. It opens the CloudFormation **Quick create stack** page with the recipe template and settings filled in. Sign in to your AWS account if asked.
2. Leave **HuggingFaceToken** empty: the model is not gated.
3. Leave **ExecutionRoleArn** empty to create a role that can only pull the container image and write logs, or set the ARN of an existing SageMaker execution role.
4. Select **I acknowledge that AWS CloudFormation might create IAM resources** and choose **Create stack**.

The stack reaches `CREATE_COMPLETE` when the endpoint `nvidia-nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b-nvfp4-g7e-48xlarge` is `InService`, usually after 10 to 30 minutes. To stop billing, delete the stack: it deletes the endpoint, the endpoint configuration, the model, and the role. [View the template](https://hf-sagemaker-recipes.s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/templates/nvidia-nvidia-nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b-nvfp4/g7e-48xlarge-vllm-tp8-ed69059c5c.json).

</hfoption>
<hfoption id="AWS CLI">

The commands create a CloudFormation stack from the recipe template, wait until the endpoint is `InService`, and delete the stack when you are done. They need the [AWS CLI](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cli/latest/userguide/getting-started-install.html).

```bash
# AWS region where the endpoint runs
REGION=us-east-1
NAME=nvidia-nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b-nvfp4-g7e-48xlarge

aws cloudformation create-stack --region "$REGION" --stack-name "$NAME" \
  --template-url https://hf-sagemaker-recipes.s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/templates/nvidia-nvidia-nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b-nvfp4/g7e-48xlarge-vllm-tp8-ed69059c5c.json \
  --capabilities CAPABILITY_IAM \
  --parameters ParameterKey=EndpointName,ParameterValue="$NAME"

# returns when the endpoint is InService; run it again if it times out after one hour
aws cloudformation wait stack-create-complete --region "$REGION" --stack-name "$NAME"
```

Delete the stack to stop billing:

```bash
aws cloudformation delete-stack --region "$REGION" --stack-name "$NAME"
```

</hfoption>
<hfoption id="Python">

The snippet calls the SageMaker APIs directly with boto3. Outside SageMaker Studio, replace `get_execution_role()` with the role lookup from [Set up the SDK](../tutorials/sagemaker-sdk/setup-sagemaker-sdk#execution-role).

```python
import os

import boto3
from sagemaker.core.helper.session_helper import Session, get_execution_role

# AWS region where the endpoint runs
region = "us-east-1"
name = "nvidia-nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b-nvfp4-g7e-48xlarge"

sess = Session(boto_session=boto3.Session(region_name=region))
role = get_execution_role()
sm = sess.boto_session.client("sagemaker")

image = f"763104351884.dkr.ecr.{region}.amazonaws.com/huggingface-vllm:0.34.0-transformers5.19.0-gpu-py312-cu130-ubuntu24.04"
environment = {
    "NCCL_IB_DISABLE": "1",
    "SAFETENSORS_FAST_GPU": "1",
    "SM_VLLM_COMPILATION_CONFIG": "{\"pass_config\":{\"fuse_allreduce_rms\":false}}",
    "SM_VLLM_DISTRIBUTED_TIMEOUT_SECONDS": "3600",
    "SM_VLLM_ENABLE_AUTO_TOOL_CHOICE": "true",
    "SM_VLLM_ENABLE_EXPERT_PARALLEL": "true",
    "SM_VLLM_ENABLE_MAMBA_CACHE_STOCHASTIC_ROUNDING": "true",
    "SM_VLLM_GPU_MEMORY_UTILIZATION": "0.95",
    "SM_VLLM_MAMBA_BACKEND": "flashinfer",
    "SM_VLLM_MAMBA_CACHE_DTYPE": "float16",
    "SM_VLLM_MAMBA_CACHE_PHILOX_ROUNDS": "5",
    "SM_VLLM_MAMBA_SSM_CACHE_DTYPE": "float16",
    "SM_VLLM_MAX_MODEL_LEN": "262144",
    "SM_VLLM_MODEL": "nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3-Ultra-550B-A55B-NVFP4",
    "SM_VLLM_MODEL_LOADER_EXTRA_CONFIG": "{\"enable_multithread_load\":true,\"num_threads\":96}",
    "SM_VLLM_REASONING_PARSER": "nemotron_v3",
    "SM_VLLM_SERVED_MODEL_NAME": "nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3-Ultra-550B-A55B-NVFP4",
    "SM_VLLM_TENSOR_PARALLEL_SIZE": "8",
    "SM_VLLM_TOOL_CALL_PARSER": "qwen3_coder"
}
# gated models need a Hugging Face token: read it from your environment
if "HF_TOKEN" in os.environ:
    environment["HF_TOKEN"] = os.environ["HF_TOKEN"]

sm.create_model(
    ModelName=name,
    ExecutionRoleArn=role,
    PrimaryContainer={"Image": image, "Environment": environment},
)
sm.create_endpoint_config(
    EndpointConfigName=name,
    ProductionVariants=[
        {
            "VariantName": "AllTraffic",
            "ModelName": name,
            "InstanceType": "ml.g7e.48xlarge",
            "InitialInstanceCount": 1,
            "InferenceAmiVersion": "al2023-ami-sagemaker-inference-gpu-4-1",
            "ContainerStartupHealthCheckTimeoutInSeconds": 3600,
        }
    ],
)
sm.create_endpoint(EndpointName=name, EndpointConfigName=name)

# wait up to 90 minutes for the endpoint to reach InService
sm.get_waiter("endpoint_in_service").wait(
    EndpointName=name, WaiterConfig={"Delay": 60, "MaxAttempts": 90}
)
```

Delete the endpoint, the endpoint configuration, and the model to stop billing:

```python
sm.delete_endpoint(EndpointName=name)
sm.delete_endpoint_config(EndpointConfigName=name)
sm.delete_model(ModelName=name)
```

</hfoptions>

The stack reaches `CREATE_COMPLETE` when the endpoint `nvidia-nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b-nvfp4-p5-48xlarge` is `InService`, usually after 10 to 30 minutes. To stop billing, delete the stack: it deletes the endpoint, the endpoint configuration, the model, and the role. [View the template](https://hf-sagemaker-recipes.s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/templates/nvidia-nvidia-nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b-nvfp4/p5-48xlarge-vllm-tp8-f401e1b115.json).

The commands create a CloudFormation stack from the recipe template, wait until the endpoint is `InService`, and delete the stack when you are done. They need the [AWS CLI](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cli/latest/userguide/getting-started-install.html).

```bash
# AWS region where the endpoint runs
REGION=us-east-1
NAME=nvidia-nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b-nvfp4-p5-48xlarge

aws cloudformation create-stack --region "$REGION" --stack-name "$NAME" \
  --template-url https://hf-sagemaker-recipes.s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/templates/nvidia-nvidia-nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b-nvfp4/p5-48xlarge-vllm-tp8-f401e1b115.json \
  --capabilities CAPABILITY_IAM \
  --parameters ParameterKey=EndpointName,ParameterValue="$NAME"

# returns when the endpoint is InService; run it again if it times out after one hour
aws cloudformation wait stack-create-complete --region "$REGION" --stack-name "$NAME"
```

Delete the stack to stop billing:

```bash
aws cloudformation delete-stack --region "$REGION" --stack-name "$NAME"
```

</hfoption>
<hfoption id="Python">

The snippet calls the SageMaker APIs directly with boto3. Outside SageMaker Studio, replace `get_execution_role()` with the role lookup from [Set up the SDK](../tutorials/sagemaker-sdk/setup-sagemaker-sdk#execution-role).

```python
import os

import boto3
from sagemaker.core.helper.session_helper import Session, get_execution_role

# AWS region where the endpoint runs
region = "us-east-1"
name = "nvidia-nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b-nvfp4-p5-48xlarge"

sess = Session(boto_session=boto3.Session(region_name=region))
role = get_execution_role()
sm = sess.boto_session.client("sagemaker")

image = f"763104351884.dkr.ecr.{region}.amazonaws.com/huggingface-vllm:0.21.0-transformers5.8.1-gpu-py312-cu130-ubuntu22.04"
environment = {
    "SAFETENSORS_FAST_GPU": "1",
    "SM_VLLM_COMPILATION_CONFIG": "{\"pass_config\":{\"fuse_allreduce_rms\":false}}",
    "SM_VLLM_DISTRIBUTED_TIMEOUT_SECONDS": "3600",
    "SM_VLLM_ENABLE_AUTO_TOOL_CHOICE": "true",
    "SM_VLLM_ENABLE_EXPERT_PARALLEL": "true",
    "SM_VLLM_ENABLE_MAMBA_CACHE_STOCHASTIC_ROUNDING": "true",
    "SM_VLLM_GPU_MEMORY_UTILIZATION": "0.95",
    "SM_VLLM_MAMBA_BACKEND": "flashinfer",
    "SM_VLLM_MAMBA_CACHE_DTYPE": "float16",
    "SM_VLLM_MAMBA_CACHE_PHILOX_ROUNDS": "5",
    "SM_VLLM_MAMBA_SSM_CACHE_DTYPE": "float16",
    "SM_VLLM_MAX_MODEL_LEN": "262144",
    "SM_VLLM_MODEL": "nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3-Ultra-550B-A55B-NVFP4",
    "SM_VLLM_MODEL_LOADER_EXTRA_CONFIG": "{\"enable_multithread_load\":true,\"num_threads\":96}",
    "SM_VLLM_REASONING_PARSER": "nemotron_v3",
    "SM_VLLM_SERVED_MODEL_NAME": "nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3-Ultra-550B-A55B-NVFP4",
    "SM_VLLM_SPECULATIVE_CONFIG": "{\"method\":\"nemotron_h_mtp\",\"num_speculative_tokens\":5}",
    "SM_VLLM_TENSOR_PARALLEL_SIZE": "8",
    "SM_VLLM_TOOL_CALL_PARSER": "qwen3_coder"
}
# gated models need a Hugging Face token: read it from your environment
if "HF_TOKEN" in os.environ:
    environment["HF_TOKEN"] = os.environ["HF_TOKEN"]

sm.create_model(
    ModelName=name,
    ExecutionRoleArn=role,
    PrimaryContainer={"Image": image, "Environment": environment},
)
sm.create_endpoint_config(
    EndpointConfigName=name,
    ProductionVariants=[
        {
            "VariantName": "AllTraffic",
            "ModelName": name,
            "InstanceType": "ml.p5.48xlarge",
            "InitialInstanceCount": 1,
            "InferenceAmiVersion": "al2023-ami-sagemaker-inference-gpu-4-1",
            "ContainerStartupHealthCheckTimeoutInSeconds": 3600,
        }
    ],
)
sm.create_endpoint(EndpointName=name, EndpointConfigName=name)

# wait up to 90 minutes for the endpoint to reach InService
sm.get_waiter("endpoint_in_service").wait(
    EndpointName=name, WaiterConfig={"Delay": 60, "MaxAttempts": 90}
)
```

Delete the endpoint, the endpoint configuration, and the model to stop billing:

```python
sm.delete_endpoint(EndpointName=name)
sm.delete_endpoint_config(EndpointConfigName=name)
sm.delete_model(ModelName=name)
```

</hfoption>
</hfoptions>

1. Pick the region and open the link. It opens the CloudFormation **Quick create stack** page with the recipe template and settings filled in. Sign in to your AWS account if asked.
2. Leave **HuggingFaceToken** empty: the model is not gated.
3. Leave **ExecutionRoleArn** empty to create a role that can only pull the container image and write logs, or set the ARN of an existing SageMaker execution role.
4. Select **I acknowledge that AWS CloudFormation might create IAM resources** and choose **Create stack**.

The stack reaches `CREATE_COMPLETE` when the endpoint `nvidia-nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b-nvfp4-p5en-48xlarge` is `InService`, usually after 10 to 30 minutes. To stop billing, delete the stack: it deletes the endpoint, the endpoint configuration, the model, and the role. [View the template](https://hf-sagemaker-recipes.s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/templates/nvidia-nvidia-nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b-nvfp4/p5en-48xlarge-vllm-tp8-ca2148b22b.json).

</hfoption>
<hfoption id="AWS CLI">

The commands create a CloudFormation stack from the recipe template, wait until the endpoint is `InService`, and delete the stack when you are done. They need the [AWS CLI](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cli/latest/userguide/getting-started-install.html).

```bash
# AWS region where the endpoint runs
REGION=us-east-1
NAME=nvidia-nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b-nvfp4-p5en-48xlarge

aws cloudformation create-stack --region "$REGION" --stack-name "$NAME" \
  --template-url https://hf-sagemaker-recipes.s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/templates/nvidia-nvidia-nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b-nvfp4/p5en-48xlarge-vllm-tp8-ca2148b22b.json \
  --capabilities CAPABILITY_IAM \
  --parameters ParameterKey=EndpointName,ParameterValue="$NAME"

# returns when the endpoint is InService; run it again if it times out after one hour
aws cloudformation wait stack-create-complete --region "$REGION" --stack-name "$NAME"
```

Delete the stack to stop billing:

```bash
aws cloudformation delete-stack --region "$REGION" --stack-name "$NAME"
```

</hfoption>
<hfoption id="Python">

The snippet calls the SageMaker APIs directly with boto3. Outside SageMaker Studio, replace `get_execution_role()` with the role lookup from [Set up the SDK](../tutorials/sagemaker-sdk/setup-sagemaker-sdk#execution-role).

```python
import os

import boto3
from sagemaker.core.helper.session_helper import Session, get_execution_role

# AWS region where the endpoint runs
region = "us-east-1"
name = "nvidia-nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b-nvfp4-p5en-48xlarge"

sess = Session(boto_session=boto3.Session(region_name=region))
role = get_execution_role()
sm = sess.boto_session.client("sagemaker")

image = f"763104351884.dkr.ecr.{region}.amazonaws.com/huggingface-vllm:0.34.0-transformers5.19.0-gpu-py312-cu130-ubuntu24.04"
environment = {
    "SAFETENSORS_FAST_GPU": "1",
    "SM_VLLM_COMPILATION_CONFIG": "{\"pass_config\":{\"fuse_allreduce_rms\":false}}",
    "SM_VLLM_DISTRIBUTED_TIMEOUT_SECONDS": "3600",
    "SM_VLLM_ENABLE_AUTO_TOOL_CHOICE": "true",
    "SM_VLLM_ENABLE_EXPERT_PARALLEL": "true",
    "SM_VLLM_ENABLE_MAMBA_CACHE_STOCHASTIC_ROUNDING": "true",
    "SM_VLLM_GPU_MEMORY_UTILIZATION": "0.95",
    "SM_VLLM_MAMBA_BACKEND": "flashinfer",
    "SM_VLLM_MAMBA_CACHE_DTYPE": "float16",
    "SM_VLLM_MAMBA_CACHE_PHILOX_ROUNDS": "5",
    "SM_VLLM_MAMBA_SSM_CACHE_DTYPE": "float16",
    "SM_VLLM_MAX_MODEL_LEN": "262144",
    "SM_VLLM_MODEL": "nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3-Ultra-550B-A55B-NVFP4",
    "SM_VLLM_MODEL_LOADER_EXTRA_CONFIG": "{\"enable_multithread_load\":true,\"num_threads\":96}",
    "SM_VLLM_REASONING_PARSER": "nemotron_v3",
    "SM_VLLM_SERVED_MODEL_NAME": "nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3-Ultra-550B-A55B-NVFP4",
    "SM_VLLM_SPECULATIVE_CONFIG": "{\"method\":\"nemotron_h_mtp\",\"num_speculative_tokens\":5}",
    "SM_VLLM_TENSOR_PARALLEL_SIZE": "8",
    "SM_VLLM_TOOL_CALL_PARSER": "qwen3_coder"
}
# gated models need a Hugging Face token: read it from your environment
if "HF_TOKEN" in os.environ:
    environment["HF_TOKEN"] = os.environ["HF_TOKEN"]

sm.create_model(
    ModelName=name,
    ExecutionRoleArn=role,
    PrimaryContainer={"Image": image, "Environment": environment},
)
sm.create_endpoint_config(
    EndpointConfigName=name,
    ProductionVariants=[
        {
            "VariantName": "AllTraffic",
            "ModelName": name,
            "InstanceType": "ml.p5en.48xlarge",
            "InitialInstanceCount": 1,
            "InferenceAmiVersion": "al2023-ami-sagemaker-inference-gpu-4-1",
            "ContainerStartupHealthCheckTimeoutInSeconds": 3600,
        }
    ],
)
sm.create_endpoint(EndpointName=name, EndpointConfigName=name)

# wait up to 90 minutes for the endpoint to reach InService
sm.get_waiter("endpoint_in_service").wait(
    EndpointName=name, WaiterConfig={"Delay": 60, "MaxAttempts": 90}
)
```

Delete the endpoint, the endpoint configuration, and the model to stop billing:

```python
sm.delete_endpoint(EndpointName=name)
sm.delete_endpoint_config(EndpointConfigName=name)
sm.delete_model(ModelName=name)
```

## Send requests

The endpoint serves the OpenAI chat completions API. SageMaker exposes it at an OpenAI-compatible route that accepts a short-lived bearer token signed with your AWS credentials, so any OpenAI client works, including streaming:

```python
from openai import OpenAI
from sagemaker.core.token_generator import generate_token

# AWS region and name of the endpoint
region = "us-east-1"
endpoint_name = "nvidia-nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b-nvfp4-g7e-48xlarge"

client = OpenAI(
    base_url=f"https://runtime.sagemaker.{region}.amazonaws.com/endpoints/{endpoint_name}/openai/v1",
    # the token is valid for up to 12 hours
    api_key=generate_token(region=region),
)

stream = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3-Ultra-550B-A55B-NVFP4",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "What is the capital of France?"}],
    max_tokens=512,
    stream=True,
)
for chunk in stream:
    if chunk.choices and chunk.choices[0].delta.content:
        print(chunk.choices[0].delta.content, end="")
```

To call the endpoint with `invoke_endpoint` instead, see [Invoke the endpoint](./deploy-a-recipe#invoke-the-endpoint).
